sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: Which soil component is mainly formed from decayed plant and animal material?
questions.explanation: Humus is organic matter produced by decomposition.

questions.question: Leguminous crops can improve soil nitrogen mainly through association with…
questions.explanation: Rhizobium and related bacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in legume root nodules.

questions.question: Which tool is commonly used for loosening soil around growing plants?
questions.explanation: A hoe loosens soil and can help with weeding around crops.

questions.question: Contour ridging on slopes helps reduce…
questions.explanation: Contour structures slow downslope runoff and can reduce erosion.

questions.question: The main purpose of vaccination in livestock is to…
questions.explanation: Vaccination helps stimulate immunity against specified infectious diseases.

questions.question: Which soil property most directly affects how quickly water drains through soil?
questions.explanation: Soil texture and structure affect pore spaces and drainage.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of crop rotation?

options.C: To reduce pest build-up and maintain soil fertility
options.D: To grow the same crop repeatedly

questions.explanation: Rotating crops can interrupt pest cycles and vary nutrient demand.
